title: 2 held with country-made pistols in Punjab's Bathinda
summary: Two individuals have been arrested in Bathinda district, Punjab, with country-made pistols recovered during the operation. The arrests are part of ongoing law enforcement efforts to control illegal firearms in the region.
digest: Police in Bathinda district arrested two persons carrying country-made pistols. The operation resulted in the seizure of illegal firearms. Further details regarding the identities of the accused, specific location of arrest, and circumstances leading to the apprehension remain to be confirmed by official police statements.

title: Maur blast case trial drags on despite HC’s push to expedite
summary: The trial proceedings in the Maur blast case continue to face delays despite the High Court's directive to expedite the legal process. The court remains committed to accelerating the case resolution.
digest: The trial related to a blast incident in Maur has not progressed as swiftly as directed by the High Court. Despite judicial orders to expedite proceedings, the case continues to experience delays in the court system. The High Court has intervened to push for faster resolution of the matter, though the trial remains ongoing.
id: maur blast case trial drags on despite hcs push to expedite

title: Two linked to jailed gangster held in Bathinda, two pistols seized
summary: Two individuals with alleged links to a jailed gangster have been arrested in Bathinda. Police recovered two pistols during the operation, strengthening efforts against organized crime networks.
digest: Bathinda police arrested two persons with connections to an incarcerated gangster. Two pistols were seized from the detainees during the arrest operation. The arrests are part of law enforcement's wider crackdown on criminal networks and illegal weapons circulation in the district.
id: two linked to jailed gangster held in bathinda two pistols seize

title: Two linked to jailed gangster held in Bathinda, arms recovered
summary: Two individuals connected to an imprisoned gangster were arrested in Bathinda, with arms recovered from their possession. The operation represents continued police action against criminal organizations.
digest: Police in Bathinda apprehended two persons linked to a gangster currently serving time in jail. Arms were recovered following the arrest, confirming illegal possession of weapons. The operation demonstrates ongoing law enforcement efforts to dismantle networks associated with incarcerated criminals operating from within the prison system.
id: two linked to jailed gangster held in bathinda arms recovered

title: AAP Bathinda MLA skips roadshow by Mann & Kejriwal, says ‘not invited’
summary: AAP's Bathinda MLA did not participate in a roadshow by Arvind Kejriwal and Bhagwant Mann, claiming he was not invited to the event.
digest: The AAP MLA representing Bathinda constituency absented himself from a roadshow conducted by AAP national convenor Arvind Kejriwal and Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann. When questioned about his absence, the MLA stated he had not received an invitation to the event. The roadshow was held in Bathinda as part of party activities in the district.
id: aap bathinda mla skips roadshow by mann kejriwal says not invite

title: Bathinda hottest at 43.8°C as heatwave returns, rain relief right behind
summary: Bathinda recorded a maximum temperature of 43.8°C as a heatwave grips the region. Weather forecasts indicate relief through incoming rainfall in the coming days.
digest: Bathinda city experienced extreme heat on the reported day, with the mercury rising to 43.8°C, marking it as the hottest location in the monitored area. The heatwave conditions continue to affect the district. However, meteorological predictions suggest that rainfall is expected to arrive soon, bringing temperature relief to the region and breaking the current heat spell.

title: Raid at Barnala facility: HC stays 17 show-cause notices issued by PPCB to Trident group
summary: बरनाला में एक सुविधा पर छापे के बाद उच्च न्यायालय ने Trident समूह को जारी किए गए 17 शो-कॉज़ नोटिस को स्थगित कर दिया है। यह PPCB द्वारा जारी किया गया था।

id: raid at barnala facility hc stays 17 show
